sources: Microsoft Learn: 'Delivery Optimization reference', Download Mode: HTTP Only (0) turns off peer-to-peer and keeps downloading over HTTP. Registry policy DODownloadMode under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DeliveryOptimization (Microsoft Learn: 'Manage connections from Windows operating system components to Microsoft services', section 28.3). The documented policy is used instead of the settings value under DeliveryOptimization\Config.
The policy is described in the Policy CSP for Pro, Enterprise and Education; Windows Home reads the same registry value, but Microsoft makes no promise for Home.
